violated_contract: An allowlisted fork seam's line budget belongs to its complete difference from upstream. The integration diff may contain upstream-authored growth and omit fork edits already present on the PR base; it cannot be used as the seam's budget measurement.
canonical_prevention: Select the files to review from the complete divergence -- the guard's --aggregate base is merge-base(head, upstream), the upstream revision actually incorporated -- and measure each selected seam directly between the upstream tree and the candidate tree. Neither half may come from the event diff: a diff-scoped base both hides a violation that landed in an earlier commit and mis-measures a seam against its increment. An unavailable upstream ref is exit 2, never a pass. Exercise a real upstream merge that preserves an existing seam, an incremental edit that exceeds the cumulative seam budget, and a violation committed before the event base.
